source: Fence-Frames Designer Components + Material Database Lew Material Catalog
notes: Airtable is the edit surface; this JSON is a build artifact for blueprint-mode.js.
Product Line tagging on catalog rows requires write access — FF Configurator Seed formula + view used until then.
si-view rails/trim defaults aligned to cedar per HOA (not PT).
vendorPricing is a hand-synced snapshot of Airtable Price+SKU fields (Home Depot/Lowe's/Dunn/Chinook) as of 2026-07-26. Re-pull manually when Airtable prices change — no live sync yet.

Chinook/Dunn have no stored per-SKU product URL (regional pro yards, no public catalog pages) — Material List mode shows their price/SKU as text, not a link. Chinook price is only included per-row when the Airtable value is a real number (some rows still have '-' placeholder SKUs/prices).

2026-07-26: pulled directly from the Material Database base (Lew Material Catalog, tblsXH5uo6T4VxCqp) once PAT access was granted — found the framing/siding/trim collated-nail rows, a gravel/aggregate row, and the SW Woodscapes stain SKU the user added, filtered via CREATED_TIME(). No loose wood-screw SKU was found in that pull, so the framing-fastener default ('#8–#10 exterior coated screws') is still unpriced — only the nail-gun alternates got linked.

2026-07-26 (follow-up): concrete-post-set now linked too — the 7 concrete-mix rows the user added don't turn up in a plain 'concrete' text search because their Item Name field renders as the literal string '---Concrete-' (an Airtable formula quirk); had to filter by Species/Type='Concrete' instead. Picked Quikrete's 60 lb 'Fence posts' bag (qtyRate bumped to 2/post = 120 lb) over the 50/80 lb sizes and the Sakrete duplicates.

Added topsoil-remediation-bag and beauty-bark-remediation-bag as siViewDefault:false, always-listed 'finish' rows so their new Airtable pricing is visible on the Material List as optional ground-remediation add-ons; bag-per-post quantity math is still unbuilt (light ≈1 bag/post, full ≈2 bags/post per earlier discussion) so qty stays coverage/null.

rows.bodyShort: Pressure-treated and incised for ground contact; posts finish level with the panel top, so no exposed post or cap in the standard build.
rows.installNote: Dig holes at least 24″ deep; aggregate base; ~120 lb concrete per post.

rows.bodyShort: Two cedar nailers carry the pickets — top and bottom on the Si View privacy build.
The 2×4 cap rides the top rail and takes the same stain as the rails — flat profile, no ornamental post caps.
Flat-top cedar boards gapped a quarter inch or less — reads as full privacy from the street while letting the fence breathe.
HOA-allowed alternate picket width (1×4). Flat top, ≤¼″ gap — same style as the 1×6 default.
rows.notes: Catalog has 1×4 dog-ear (458507) but not a flat-top 1×4 fencing SKU yet.

rows.bodyShort: A single 1×4 cedar trim band at the top rail finishes the panel edge — same species, same stain as the rest of the fence.
Every visible fence, post, and gate must be stained within 60 days with Sherwin-Williams Woodscapes Semi-transparent Exterior Stain, custom formula 3558-789 (Asteroid). One color for the whole fence.
rows.notes: Product identity is SW formula 3558-789 — no Home Depot/Lowe's catalog # (custom-tint stain), only stocked through Dunn Lumber's SW dealer counter.
rows.qtyCoverageNotes: Coverage per gallon unknown; price shown is per 5-gal pail, not per gallon.

rows.bodyShort: Roughly 120 lb of concrete per post for Si View dig-and-set installs — two 60 lb bags.
rows.installNote: Dig ≥24″; aggregate base; ~120 lb concrete per post.
rows.notes: Airtable's Item Name renders as '---Concrete-' for these (formula quirk) — not findable by text search, only by Species/Type='Concrete' or Category='Concrete Formwork'. Picked the Quikrete 60 lb bag tagged 'Fence posts' (full 4-vendor pricing) over the 50 lb/80 lb sizes and the Sakrete-branded duplicates (missing Dunn/Chinook, and some share suspiciously identical SKUs with the Quikrete rows — likely placeholder data).

rows.bodyShort: Aggregate base under posts per Si View install notes.
rows.installNote: Aggregate base in hole before setting post.

rows.bodyShort: Stainless steel framing fasteners for rail-to-post connections.
rows.notes: Priced row is the 0.131″×3.25″ stainless 21° coil framing nail (matches this row's displayName). Live default framing-fastener dropdown is '#8–#10 exterior coated screws' — no screw SKU was found in the 2026-07-26 Airtable pull, so that option is still unpriced.
rows.qtyCoverageNotes: Box-count math not yet modeled — informational only.

rows.bodyShort: Optional post-build ground remediation — spread topsoil where digging disturbed the yard. Light remediation (1:2 to concrete) = 1 bag per post; Full remediation (1:1 to concrete) = 2 bags per post.
rows.installNote: Optional add-on; not included in the standard Si View build unless requested.
rows.qtyCoverageNotes: Light remediation: 1 bag/post (1:2 to concrete); Full remediation: 2 bags/post (1:1 to concrete).

rows.bodyShort: Optional finishing touch after ground remediation — bark cover over disturbed soil along the fence line. Light remediation (1:2 to concrete) = 1 bag per post; Full remediation (1:1 to concrete) = 2 bags per post.
